extracted.finding: TWO DEFECTS in the reported findings' handling of the $47 / $130 example figures
extracted.defect_1_misattribution: Reported findings attribute these figures to balance-part-d-plans-rfa.pdf ('RFA plan examples') and direct remediation to 'a direct read of balance-part-d-plans-rfa.pdf Appendix C and its example tables.' The figures actually appear in the BALANCE Model PDE submission guidance (balance-cy27-pde-submission-guidance.pdf) as prescription-drug-event reporting illustrations. Remediation is pointed at the wrong document.
extracted.defect_2_spurious_inconsistency: Reported findings assert 'the $130/three-month figure is inconsistent with the $50 per 28-30 day cap.' $130 for a three-month supply is approximately $43.33 per month, i.e. BELOW the $50 per 28-or-30-day ceiling. $47 for one month is likewise below $50. There is no inconsistency; the claimed conflict is a reasoning error.
extracted.example_detail: BALANCE Plan or EGWP example: model drug on a tier with $47.00 copay for a one-month supply (ingredient cost $499.00, dispensing fee $5.00), and a tier with $130.00 copay for a three-month supply (ingredient cost $1,497.00, dispensing fee $5.00)
extracted.shared_conclusion: These are illustrative reporting examples, not operative prices. They must not ship as prices. Agreed with the reported findings on that point.
